data.body: Root verification confirmed shipped help omissions. The create parser accepts --detected-by and the command core documents its provenance semantics, but src/rebar/_cli/help/create.txt omits the option. The transition parser accepts --caused-by and --ref. The transition usage line omits both, the body explains --ref outside the usage, and it does not explain --caused-by. The generated CLI reference inherits these source omissions. Wording and completeness corrections must coordinate with premium-drizzly-weaverbird because that ticket owns parser unification and generated canonical help.
